description: Search MyDisease.info for diseases by free-text name or fielded query. Returns matching hits, each keyed by a MONDO disease id (e.g. "MONDO:0015967") with the best-matching ontology and annotation keys. Use this to resolve a disease name to canonical ontology ids before calling the "disease" tool. Free text like "diabetes" or "asthma" works; fielded queries like "mondo.label:asthma" or "disgenet.xrefs.disease_name:..." narrow the search.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of annotation fields to return (default: all fields).

query.description: Free-text disease name (e.g. "diabetes") or a fielded query (e.g. "mondo.label:asthma").

name: query
title: Query
